$comment: Catalog of available Microverse brand themes. Each theme is a self-contained bundle under its own dir (at minimum css/light.css + css/dark.css; Vienna/Uhuru also carry their own images/backgroundImage since they have unique artwork, Default doesn't and has no backgroundImage field here — it inherits tokens.css's own --mv-bg-image-url). This file does NOT decide which theme is active; that's MICROVERSE_BRAND_THEME (see root .env / .env.example), baked at build time into both applications/taskfusion (as REACT_APP_BRAND_THEME, read by src/context/ThemeContext.js) and infrastructure/keycloak (as KEYCLOAK_BRAND_THEME, consumed by the Dockerfile — Keycloak has no JS runtime, so it can't read [data-brand-theme] the way taskfusion does; see that Dockerfile's own comments). defaultTheme below is only the fallback used when the env var is unset.

themes.label: Default
themes.description: Base Microverse theme, blue primary. No cultural narrative by design — every other theme starts here and swaps the palette.

themes.label: Vienna
themes.description: Schönbrunn/Belvedere palette — pine hedge-green primary, spring-green live-status accent, Schönbrunn ochre as the single warm accent.

themes.label: Uhuru
themes.description: Pan-African red/gold/green/black palette — ember-red primary, savanna-green live-status accent, dawn gold as the single warm accent.
